name: Graphic Design
title: Graphic Design
intro: The graphic design roadmap: design fundamentals, software, portfolio, degrees and first job.

phases.title: Class 10–12: start sketching and observing
phases.summary: Any stream; practise drawing and look closely at design around you.
points: Graphic design is open to students from any stream.
Collect examples of good posters, logos and packaging and note why they work.
Practise drawing and composition; it helps design thinking.
Learn basic computer skills and free tools like Canva.

phases.title: Degree options and entrance
phases.summary: B.Des, BFA or short professional courses.
points: B.Des programmes admit through UCEED (IIT design programmes), NID DAT, NIFT and institute entrance tests.
BFA (Applied Art) is available at art colleges via their entrance exams.
Diplomas and certificates provide a faster route into the industry.
Check the faculty’s portfolio and student work before choosing.

phases.title: Design fundamentals
points: Learn layout, hierarchy, colour theory, typography and grid systems.
Study branding, logo design and visual identity.
Learn print basics, such as colour modes and file formats.
Practise with daily design challenges.

phases.title: Software and specialisation
phases.summary: Master the tools of the trade.
points: Learn Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign and Figma.
Explore specialisations such as branding, packaging, motion graphics or UI design.
Build brand identity, poster, packaging and social media design projects.
Learn how to present and defend design decisions.

phases.title: Portfolio and job entry
phases.summary: Show a coherent set of projects.
points: Build a portfolio with 6–10 strong projects and publish on Behance or a personal site.
Intern with agencies, studios and in-house design teams.
Apply for roles such as graphic designer, visual designer and brand designer.
Freelance work and competitions add experience.
